design_vision.description: An award-worthy (Awwwards-style), single-page ePortfolio for an AIML Business Analyst with 17+ years of experience. The vibe is 'Modern Data/Tech' merging technical CLI/Terminal precision with high-end, luxury editorial layouts. No 'AI slop' purple gradients. High contrast, sheer blacks, 1px grid lines, and kinetic typographic reveals.

headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, large display text. Must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for impact. NO Inter/Space Grotesk.

body.usage: Paragraphs, long-form reading, contact form labels. Provides a clean, slightly technical structure.

accents.usage: Numbers, data metrics (95%+, 20%), terminal prompts, code snippets, section numbers (01, 02), and UI labels. Gives the 'data/tech' credibility.

usage_rules.base: Deep Obsidian (240 10% 4%) is the core background. Never use pure black.
usage_rules.accents: Use Cyan (180 100% 50%) for primary interactions and links. Use Matrix Green (150 100% 50%) strictly for terminal/code emulation sections (like the PIN gate).
usage_rules.borders: Exposed grid aesthetic. Use 1px borders (border-border) extensively to create a blueprint/dashboard feel.
usage_rules.gradients: BANNED: No purple/pink SaaS gradients. ALLOWED: Subtle black-to-transparent fades for masking.

layouts.spacing_system: Generous. Use py-24 to py-32 for section padding. Internal card padding should be p-8 to p-12.

grid_strategy.bento: Use asymmetrical bento grids for the 'About' and 'Pipeline' sections. Mix 2-col and 1-col spans.
grid_strategy.exposed_skeleton: Container should have border-collapse style layout. Items have subtle borders on right and bottom of every grid item.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky header. backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/50 with a 1px border-b.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle SVG noise overlay (mix-blend-overlay, opacity 5%) over the entire page to kill the digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: Sharp corners or very subtle radius (max rounded-md / 6px). Avoid heavily rounded bubbly corners.

sections_blueprint.name: Header / Nav
sections_blueprint.details: Sticky glassmorphism header. Left: 'GR_' monospace logo. Right: Nav links (01. About, 02. Skills, etc.) + Resume CTA button.

sections_blueprint.name: Hero Section
sections_blueprint.details: Kinetic text reveal on load. Huge 'Gopikrishna Rajendran'. Sub: 'Assistant Manager | AIML - Business Analyst'. Include the professional headshot using a stark clipping mask or inner glow frame. Background: Abstract dotted sphere 3D aesthetic.

sections_blueprint.name: About / Profile
sections_blueprint.details: Bento grid layout. 17+ Years ITES metric highlighted in massive monospace. Languages mapped as data points.

sections_blueprint.name: Skills Grid
sections_blueprint.details: Code-inspired execution. Terminal window UI wrapping skills (Python, Streamlit, PostgreSQL, Tableau, GenAI). Typing animation effect.

sections_blueprint.name: Experience Timeline
sections_blueprint.details: Vertical timeline spanning TCS, Cognizant, Oracle, RNTBCI, HSBC. KPIs (95%+ accuracy, 20% savings) highlighted in Cyan.

sections_blueprint.name: Live Projects
sections_blueprint.details: Grid of 9 deployed Streamlit/HF apps. 1px bordered cards. Hover state reveals abstract data texture and external link icon.

sections_blueprint.name: Academic Projects (PIN Gated)
sections_blueprint.details: Terminal-style lock screen. User must enter 4-digit PIN. Shows blinking cursor `> ENTER PIN: _`. Unlocks a gallery of 12+ items. Uses Matrix Green accent.

sections_blueprint.name: Pipeline / Upcoming
sections_blueprint.details: Categorized via Tabs: Projects, Games, Hobbies (Rubik's cube, Sketching, Cooking).

sections_blueprint.name: Manifesto & Marquee
sections_blueprint.details: Numbered chapters (01. Data, 02. Insight). Slow editorial marquee scrolling horizontally with key mantras.

sections_blueprint.name: Contact & Socials
sections_blueprint.details: Working contact form. Monospace label styling. Links for LinkedIn, GitHub, HuggingFace, Email.

motion.scrolling: Smooth momentum scrolling using @studio-freight/lenis is MANDATORY.
motion.reveals: Use framer-motion for viewport triggers. Fade up and slight y-axis translation on scroll. Staggered children for grids.
motion.hover_states: Interactive elements must shift text color and background. Cards should have a subtle 1px border color change (border-border to border-primary) on hover.

shadcn: Input / Textarea: Remove default Vercel glow. Use stark 1px border, bg-transparent, focus:border-primary focus:ring-0.
Button: Sharp corners, highly technical. Primary buttons: bg-primary text-black hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-colors.
Card: Remove shadow, use bg-card, 1px border-border, rounded-none or rounded-sm.
component_instructions.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, PIN gate) MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='pin-input').

media_and_assets.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react (Duotone or regular weight, very precise).

headshot.description: User's real professional photo, treated with a dark background or clipping mask to blend into the theme.

abstract_cubes.description: Abstract blockchain/data cubes. Use for Project backgrounds or Skills section textures.

abstract_sphere.description: Dotted 3D sphere. Excellent for Hero section background or Manifesto overlay. Apply opacity-20.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: DO NOT output generic centered layouts or bubbly soft shadows.
NO universal CSS transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties.
Text readability is paramount: Ensure high contrast ratios (APCA/WCAG AA).
Never use purely transparent backgrounds under text that overlaps images/scrolling content.
Include data-testid on every clickable or form element.
Ensure UI is strictly dark-theme by default (class='dark').
Do not hallucinate logos. Use icon libraries for tech stack logos (react-icons/si) or standard text if unavailable.
